privacy_rules: Private manifest, audio, references and transcript text MUST remain outside the repository.
Persisted benchmark evidence may contain only digests, category labels, model/adapter identity and technical/quality metrics.
Machine-generated transcripts MUST NOT be used as reference ground truth.
selection_rules: Qwen remains default unless a private corpus satisfies minimum sample count and category coverage.
WER and CER require human-corrected reference text.
RTF, wall time and GPU memory are independent performance axes and cannot substitute for WER/CER.
Cloud results may be compared separately but cannot automatically change the local default.
